context: Pages 1 and 2 include shared page 0; native page 0 alone is not requested because the command interprets it as page 1.
Input, dropdown and listbox values are unresolved design-time expressions. No runtime data is invented.
Named screenshots and WebKit SVG snapshots are static comparisons, not live DIALOG, loaded-form, printing or Finder captures.
Native engines use isolated writable copies. No installed application, global appearance or user settings are modified.

The authored corpus retains compatibilityVersion 2000. Native writable project metadata defaults to 2100 (21 LTS compatible) to avoid the legacy-component import prompt, even with dependencies.json present; form and resource bytes are unchanged.
External JSON pointers are a resolved-preview versus named-native context gap, not silently scored renderer errors. Live runtime pointer resolution has not been verified.
The automaticAlternate rectangle header resolves to black in native named captures. Its live runtime appearance has not been verified.
